root_idea.summary: The root centers on going ahead, preceding, or being in front of what follows.
root_idea.development: From precedence and temporal priority develop meanings for those who went before, acts or payments sent ahead, first portions or extracts, and things that lead or arrive first. Several specialized homonymous branches are separately attested in Classical Arabic.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form سَلَفَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect citation form أَسْلَفَ rather than the supplied inflected forms.
Displayed as the nominal citation form سَلَف.

senses.definition: To go before, pass before, or be past and over; to have passed away or come to an end.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the form describes what has preceded or become past, including prior conduct that is treated as belonging to the past.

senses.definition: To put or send forward beforehand; to do or send ahead.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses concern an action or provision performed beforehand and thereby counted as sent ahead; the separate commercial and lending constructions are Classical extensions listed below.

senses.definition: A predecessor or preceding one; one who or that which has gone before.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic expression refers to those made to stand before later people as something preceding them.

senses.definition: A precedent or preceding example held up for later people.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the preceding group is presented as an example or precedent for those who come afterward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The making of a thing to go before or precede.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a good or righteous deed to precede someone as preparation for a future reward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction سَلَفَ لَهُ عَمَلٌ صَالِحٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be foremost or to precede others in reaching the watering place, especially of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptive Form I and adjectival usage apply to an animal that arrives ahead of others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn over or level land for sowing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively with land as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To oil or grease a leather water-bag.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive use with a leather water-bag as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone an early portion of food called a سُلْفَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recipient may be a man, a group, or a party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat an early portion of food called a سُلْفَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A food-related Form II or Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep pace or run with another, or to vie and compete with him in going.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III reciprocal construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To equal another in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III construction expressing equivalence in a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pay in advance for a described commodity to be delivered at a specified future time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial Form IV construction, including payment for a measured or weighed commodity for which the seller is responsible.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lend property, with no profit to the lender, for return in kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with property as the object of the loan.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do a good or evil action with the expectation that it will be requited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of advancing something for later recompense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To receive payment in advance or to take what is called a سَلَف.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V usage concerning an advance or advance payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To receive a loan from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْهُ and a borrowed thing or amount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For two men to marry two sisters, one man marrying one sister and the other the other sister.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI kinship usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand money or property from someone as a loan.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X request for a loan, including a request for a young camel as a loan.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand the price of something in advance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X commercial construction equivalent to seeking a loan of the price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take as one's wife the wife of one's deceased brother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form X usage reported in connection with a levirate marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A travelling-provisions bag, especially a large leather bag; also a hide that has not been thoroughly tanned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word has variant descriptions in the lexical evidence, including a large جِرَاب and an incompletely tanned hide.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Preceding ancestors or relations older than and superior to a person in age or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical application of سَلَفٌ to a person's forebears and earlier relations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The early leading Muslims or earlier generations regarded as models; by extension, their doctrines or tenets.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional historical and religious application, including expressions such as السلف الصالح and مذاهب السلف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A people or party going before others in a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective Classical use referring to a group preceding another group in travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or group of men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general collective noun use, not necessarily emphasizing temporal precedence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good or righteous deed performed beforehand as a preparation for future reward, or a cause of reward that goes before a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for an act or other cause of recompense sent ahead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Payment made in advance for a commodity to be delivered later according to its description.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A commercial sale in which the price is paid beforehand and delivery is deferred to a specified period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A loan returned in kind and without profit to the lender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lender's expected recompense is thanks or reward rather than financial profit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stallion-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prepuce of a boy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical usage reported alongside variant vocalizations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The husband of one's wife's sister; in the dual, the two husbands of two sisters, with related terms for the corresponding female relationship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Kinship terminology varies by number, gender, and dialectal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The young of a partridge or of the قَطَاة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical authorities differ on the particular bird intended.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One after another, in successive order.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression جَاؤُوا سُلْفَةً سُلْفَةً for arrivals following closely upon one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An early or light portion of food taken before the main meal, especially food provided for a guest before the meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A portion used to allay hunger or to receive a visitor before the customary midday meal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece or portion of seed-producing land that has been made even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized agricultural noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thin skin used as a lining for boots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lining may be red or yellow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land containing few trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of sparsely wooded land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The first, clearest, or purest liquid that flows from grapes, dates, raisins, or similar produce, especially before pressing or dilution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also be applied to wine generally or to the first extract of anything.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A swift or fleet horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow having a long head, or a long arrowhead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting or weapon term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A road or way.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the participial sense of passing or preceding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Passing, passing away, coming to an end, or going before; as a collective military noun, the van of an army.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The participial form is also used of preceding peoples and generations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side or upper part of the front of the neck, from the earring's suspension to the hollow of the collarbone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun, with سَوَالِفُ as a plural.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Locks of hair hanging down along the side of the front of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic extension from the anatomical location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The front part of a horse's neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal-anatomical application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affinity by marriage between two people, especially through their having married sisters.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression بَيْنَهُمَا أُسْلُوفَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who has reached middle age, traditionally about forty-five years old.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet specially applied to a female.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument for making land even, such as a stone roller.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tool used to level prepared land; in later usage it may refer to a harrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made even, or smooth and soft, of ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal or specialized description of level ground, including the traditional phrase for the ground of Paradise.

cautions: Two Lane units remain unresolved rather than being treated as settled meanings: the disputed transitive Form I report and the possibly mistranscribed bird entry under سُلْفٌ.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:slf:41885:g1:sub4 reports a transitive Form I meaning equivalent to making a thing pass or precede, but the editor notes that the cited K source does not support it; it is therefore not presented as a settled Classical meaning.

lane-unit:slf:41894:g1:main gives a bird sense for سُلْفٌ while explicitly suggesting that the form may be a mistranscription for سُلَفٌ; the uncertain assignment is retained in the ledger rather than silently merged with the separate young-bird sense.
